name: Brief
why: A thread's brief, from the owner's question to a thread that needs no second question
ideal: A brief states its guards, reaches a thread in one message, starts within minutes and is never asked about twice.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
Claude Code Docs: How Claude remembers your project

steps.name: Ask
steps.rule: A question for the owner goes out as one decision card.

steps.name: Write
steps.rule: Each guard is said in a file a cloud thread reads.

steps.name: Load
steps.rule: The memory index adds few tokens to a thread at start.

steps.name: Start
steps.rule: A thread starts within minutes of the owner's message.

steps.name: Recall
steps.rule: A thread never asks what memory already says.
